candidates.title: Adventure Travel 365: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
candidates.description: Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life. We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi, where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more. This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us. What You’ll Help Us Build The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. Some of the functionality we’re planning includes: Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management Job and project tracking Client and vendor dashboards Online payments and transaction tracking Reviews and ratings Notifications and communications Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities Admin tools for managing
